fee_notes: Fee varies based on designated territory size and population. A population of 100,000 or less indicates a fee of $2,500; a population of 1 million or more indicates $25,000. For converting businesses, prior gross billings track record is also a factor. 100% due at signing of Franchise Agreement. Up to $5,000 is non-refundable if franchisee fails to qualify or complete initial training; balance is refunded. An additional $1,000 software fee is payable prior to opening and is non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee varies between $2,500 to $25,000, depending on which designated territory(ies) in which your franchise business will operate, or an amount within that range that we may agree upon with you. Generally, the larger the expected growth rate and size of population in a given territory, the larger the initial franchise fee.
